instruction: Set the autosave interval to 3 minutes in LibreOffice.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully disabled Presenter Console by navigating Tools > Options > LibreOffice Impress > General and unchecking 'Enable Presenter Console', then clicking Apply.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice menus, open Tools > Options dialog, navigate settings tree, toggle checkboxes, apply changes
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same settings navigation capability but targets a different setting (autosave interval under Load/Save) requiring dropdown/spinbox interaction instead of a checkbox
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Tools > Options > Load/Save > General and setting autosave interval to 3 minutes. Evaluator uses existing check_auto_saving_time metric which parses registrymodifications.xcu to verify AutoSaveTimeIntervall value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches registrymodifications.xcu from the VM, which is the LibreOffice config file that stores user setting modifications including autosave interval.
Metric check_auto_saving_time correctly parses the XML to find AutoSaveTimeIntervall under /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document and compares it to the expected 3 minutes.
Expected value type is 'rule' with rules={'minutes': 3}. The metric receives the rules dict directly as the second parameter and accesses rules['minutes'] correctly.
Complete instruction coverage: the single requirement (set autosave interval to 3 minutes) is fully verified by the evaluator.
No postconfig needed since the evaluator reads a persistent config file, not a transient UI state.
